digest.component_or_area: store, reducer, graph and snapshot subsystems
propositions: Comment triage alone cannot reduce two size-pressured files (_store/event_append.py at 791/800, reducer/_processors.py at 777/800) because their comments encode load-bearing replay-compatibility and migration guard rationale that must be preserved verbatim.

Four verified-stale comments must be corrected in place rather than deleted: _store/gitutil.py incorrectly claims no rebar.* imports despite a deferred function-local import; reducer/llm_format.py cites obsolete package path and omits four live KEY_MAP variants; _store/hlc.py states a kill-switch revert applied 'for one release' despite still being wired and tested four schema bumps later; reducer/_filters.py justifies itself by a bash/Python duality that no longer exists.

The wire-format changelog exists in two homes (reducer/_version.py and docs/event-schema.md) with docs holding a partial, stale copy missing v4 and v5; the canonical home must be completed before the code copy is collapsed to a citation.

The snapshot-restore migration guards at reducer/_processors.py:719-774 must remain in place because relocating their rationale would obscure live guards as dead code, and one guard explicitly warns it must not run unconditionally to avoid clobbering a recorded channel.
